input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，Both parts express time, so using them together is redundant. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个：另一个，This refers to one different city; 别的 distinguishes other things or people from a previously mentioned one, while 另一个 is needed for one additional/different city. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，This is the first mention of both characters, so introduce the boy with his name and identity, and identify the other character as his mother. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，After the recent mention of Mengzi, use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence because no other male character competes as the referent. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市，The city has not been introduced before, so the demonstrative reference is unclear; use a full noun phrase to identify it. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，The mother was named earlier in the same sentence, so a pronoun is natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠墓地的家里，This describes a living situation rather than a completed action, so it takes no 了; the location follows 住在. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A routine marked by 每天 uses the zero particle, not completion marker 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，Put 了 after the directional/resultative element 到. [teacher rule: le_placement]

items.reason: 古代 and 的时候 redundantly express the time frame, and 在古代 is correct.
别一个城市 is not the appropriate expression here; 另一个城市 is correct.
The first mention needs a clearer introduction of Mengzi and his mother, but the proposed replacement ends as an incomplete coordination.
孩子 is vague in this context, while 他 can clearly refer back to the recently mentioned Mengzi.
那个城市 refers to a city that has not previously been introduced, whereas 在他们住的城市 identifies it.
Repeating 孟母 here is acceptable and clear, so replacing it with 她 is only a stylistic alternative.
住了在 has both incorrect location word order and an inappropriate perfective 了 for a living state.
每天 describes a routine, so 祭拜 should not take completion marker 了.
The 了 must follow 到 in the directional-complement structure 搬到了.
